description: Refactor forward-mcp to use hex (ports & adapters) layered architecture

specs.description: Domain entities are independent of any external packages
specs.given: A new domain entity type added to domain/entities/
specs.when: go build is run on the domain package
specs.then: Build succeeds with zero dependencies on internal/adapters, internal/ports, internal/usecases

domain_conventions.rule: Domain layer must have zero external Go dependencies (except stdlib)

specs.description: Port interfaces define contracts between layers
specs.given: An adapter implementation needs to communicate with external systems
specs.when: A port interface is defined in ports/
specs.then: The interface uses only domain types in its method signatures

domain_conventions.rule: Ports may only import domain layer, not adapters

specs.description: Forward API client adapter compiles and works
specs.given: The forward API client is moved to internal/adapters/forward

specs.description: Semantic cache adapter uses port interfaces
specs.given: The semantic cache is refactored to use ports.CacheInterface
specs.then: The cache implementation satisfies the port contract

specs.given: The NQE database code is moved to internal/adapters/database
The memory system code is moved to internal/adapters/memory

specs.description: Bloom search adapter compiles and integrates
specs.given: The bloom search code is moved to internal/adapters/cache

specs.description: Use cases orchestrate through port interfaces
specs.given: The MCP service in usecases/ uses adapters through ports
specs.when: A tool is invoked via MCP
specs.then: The usecases layer has no direct import of adapter implementations

domain_conventions.rule: Use cases import only ports, not concrete adapters

specs.description: CLI entry point builds with new structure
specs.given: cmd/server/main.go is updated to new package paths

specs.description: Full test suite passes with hex architecture
specs.given: All code has been refactored to hex structure
specs.then: All tests pass (or known failures are documented)

specs.given: External code imports the old internal/service package

specs.description: No adapter imports another adapter directly
specs.then: No import path contains internal/adapters/* (except self)

domain_conventions.rule: Adapters must communicate through ports, not directly
